results.title: While We Are Here
results.overview: Through a tapestry of letters, journals, and art, Chicago-based artist Reveca Torres engages in a dialogue with iconic disabled artists Frida Kahlo, Vincent Van Gogh, and Henri Matisse who have inspired a new generation of artists. Bridging time and space, she intertwines the lives and works of Kahlo, Van Gogh, and Matisse with the works of contemporary artists with disabilities.

results.title: Sonographic Memories
results.overview: After the sudden death of his pregnant mother, a seemingly unbreakable barrier is formed between a teenage boy and his father. He attempts to find solace at the playground he used to go to with his mother, yet it only serves as a reminder of what could’ve been.

results.title: Sterile
results.overview: Through crucifixions, fisting and forest rituals, a group of queer and trans friends create a folk-horror love letter to radical intimacies. Produced over 6 years, Sterile offers a utopian/dystopian vision blending original footage with once banned silent movie Häxan (1922), practical special effects, explicit performance and commentary to present a joyous, affirmative documentary about lost times in nature in a trans- and queerphobic world.

results.title: Nowhere to Lay My Eyes
results.overview: With her brother, Sanghee visits her mother on Jeju Island. It’s been 10 years. Her mother's restaurant has become a hit. Her stepfather is making a film about a "grass tomb". His daughter has just started painting. Previously unknown facts, needless advice and cheap compliments are passed back and forth. On the morning of her departure, the other family members watch one of Sanghee's films.

results.title: A Pulga
results.overview: One hot night, a child captures the ‘beast’ that has long haunted the chicken coops in their village. The next day, racked with guilt at having hunted it down, she joins her cousins to save it from the adults’ punishment, but hides the fact that it was her hand that wounded it.

results.title: The Tuk Tuk Guy
results.overview: Comedy hybrid short film following a Tuk Tuk driver who, while being questioned by two officers, recounts his previous night’s surreal experiences through an animated "stoned" lens. Five stories overlap as Hamama, the Tuk Tuk driver, tries to figure out what Hossam and Refaat want to know specifically Hossam, who came here for a truly weird reason.

results.title: sich langsam nähern - Begleitetes Lebensende in sieben Kapiteln
results.original_title: sich langsam nähern - Begleitetes Lebensende in sieben Kapiteln
results.overview: In seven astute chapters, this film documents the work of doctors and nurses in the palliative care unit at Vienna General Hospital or outpatient hospice care, accompanying patients on their final journey. Although we see family members and impending goodbyes in the dialogues, the film gradually delves deeper into the relationship between the dying and their healthcare professionals: repeatedly, the tension between professional care and emotional closeness is palpable.

results.title: REBORDOSE
results.overview: Ramona spends a night of excess with her best friend, but a tragedy at dawn changes everything. Haunted by the trauma, she must face consequences that will alter her life forever, trapping her in a reality that feels like an endless hangover.

results.title: Whispers in the Water
results.overview: Two men share moments of intimacy while one of them questions the **superficiality of a relationship that, despite its length, was never truly built**. Between desire, silence, touch, and fleeting smiles, **unease rises from a shallow bond sustained by the fear of diving deeper and truly feeling**.

results.title: Nurse: Empathy Heals
results.overview: While people may think they know what nurses do, this documentary reveals the emotional challenges nurses face on a daily basis when caring for patients. These are nurses’ stories about compassion and empathy, the grief that doesn’t disappear, and the catharsis that comes from being heard. Through these personal stories, revealing the moments of doubt, faith, grief, joy, and fierce love that shape every act of care, the film celebrates nurses as the heroes they truly are.

results.title: Passing The Bar
results.overview: A job interview at a cocktail bar goes wildly off-menu when the interviewer decides to down every drink made for him.

results.title: Marie Madeleine
results.overview: In Jacmel, Haiti, the sea, the churches, and the spirits shape daily life. Marie Madeleine is a free woman. She makes a living as a prostitute and navigates the nights without submitting to the rules of those who save souls. Her path crosses Joseph's, a young evangelist. A relationship blossoms between these two opposite beings. As Joseph’s faith wavers, Marie Madeleine draws him into a world where desire and the quest for freedom open up a space where everything can be reinvented.

results.title: Still Shining
results.overview: In the 1940s, Soon-ok and Jeong-eem dream of leaving home to chase music and freedom. But a sudden tragedy in the community shatters innocence, forcing Soon-ok into an unexpected marriage. Jeong-eem disappears under mysterious circumstances, leaving Soon-ok burdened with guilt and unanswered questions. Decades later, the elderly Soon-ok reunites with Jeong-eem, who remembers nothing of their past.

results.title: Home Address: Womb
results.overview: A mother gives birth to her newborn and gets filled with instant dread. She doesn’t want to see her child grow up and leave her. So she arranges to have her baby pushed back into her womb. Her son grows up inside of her, where she can keep him safe.

results.title: My Best P@l
results.overview: A young and massive metal pole becomes an unusual vehicle for desire. Through the fantasy of being loved – and fucked – the film playfully blurs the boundaries between object and subject, intimacy and projection. In a short, provocative form, it queers the understanding of the body, eroticism and desire, revealing their absurd and yet surprisingly human dimensions.

results.title: The Virgins
results.overview: Two straight-A high school girls break free for a secret weekend, unknowingly attracting the attention of two angry young men.

results.title: Private Restroom
results.overview: Under the skin of every city lies a thick layer of crime, managed globally by an unlikely front: Private Restrooms. They aren't hidden beneath the surface, but in plain sight-where you see them every day, yet never look close enough...
